counterfactual.change: Reduced initial vx from 8.88 to 3.0 (one field) with same steps/walls/dt; body no longer reaches right edge within 69 steps so in_arena violation disappears.

explanation: Shrunk scenario has single free circle (r=1.13) starting at x=15.4 moving right at vx=8.88 with gravity 9.81 and no walls. No horizontal forces or boundary collision response is applied (vx constant across steps), so the body drifts ballistically past the right arena edge. At step 68 x=18.996 -> right edge 20.127 (overshoot 0.127 <0.15) and at step 69 x=19.049 -> right edge 20.180 (overshoot 0.179 >0.15), triggering in_arena. Reducing initial vx is sufficient to keep the body inside for the same 69 steps, confirming the unbounded horizontal coasting is the cause.
vision_note: The red circle moves continuously to the right toward the black vertical arena boundary with no bounce or deflection. From step 66 to 69 it gets progressively closer and then visibly protrudes beyond the right edge, remaining outside the arena.
